understanding.goal: Shift the whole colour scheme toward warm, earthy tones: clay, sand, umber, rust and ochre.
preserves: role of each colour (terracotta on 'Living' and the lit room, ochre as second)

summary: I moved every colour role to warmer, earthier values: a sand-clay paper ground, deep umber instead of near-black ink, a richer rust-terracotta accent and a baked ochre, with a brown-grey for the quiet lines; layout and words are untouched.
